items.name: Iterable - Handlebars
items.description: Writes, explains, and debugs Handlebars personalization for Iterable email, SMS, and push templates — merge tags, helpers (text, math, date, looping, conditional, regex, encoding/hashing), built-in merge tags, and troubleshooting.

items.name: Klaviyo - Email Operations
items.description: Plans and builds Klaviyo email operations — campaigns vs. flows vs. transactional distinction, API-based transactional email templates (order/shipping/password/invoice/account events), flow-driven content via webhooks and custom actions, email/SMS consent and compliance, deliverability and sender authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and email metrics/analytics.

items.name: Klaviyo - Liquid Personalisations
items.description: Authors Klaviyo message-template personalization using the Django-based template language — template variables (recipient, account, event), template tags (unsubscribe, web view, manage preferences, dates), conditionals and loops, filters (lookup, default, floatformat), custom-coded HTML blocks, catalog lookup tags for dynamic product recommendations, and AMP markup with verbatim tags.

items.name: SFMC - AMPSCRIPT
items.description: Writes, explains, and debugs AMPscript for Salesforce Marketing Cloud emails, landing pages, and CloudPages, covering personalization, data lookups, conditional logic, and error handling.

items.name: SFMC - Automation
items.description: Plans, builds, and troubleshoots SFMC Automation Studio automations (scheduled, triggered, file-drop), covering activity sequencing, error handling, and monitoring.

items.name: SFMC - Journey
items.description: Designs, configures, and troubleshoots SFMC Journey Builder journeys: entry sources, decision and engagement splits, wait steps, email activities, and exit criteria.

items.name: SFMC - SQL
items.description: Generates SFMC Query Studio SQL for Data Extension queries, Data View joins, subscriber segmentation, engagement filtering, and scheduled query activities, with Marketing Cloud Engagement best practices for readable, explicit, maintainable, and tested SQL.
